StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Hell_is_Us
Fandom (hell-is-us.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://hell-is-us.fandom.com/wiki/Hell_is_Us
notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a perfect stub). Its Walkthrough, Gameplay, Controls, Enemies and "Achievements and trophies" pages are linked but not written; the only written subpage is "Table of Contents". hellisus.fandom.com returned HTTP 404; hell-is-us.fandom.com has a "Hell is Us" page with no linked pages; nothing copied. The Steam schema names the game "Hell is Us" (app 1620730). 16 of 40 Steam achievements are hidden; their names (for example "War Correspondent", "Historian", "Demonologist", "Well-Read", "Keymaster") suggest collections and side goals, but with no descriptions they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. "Legend of the Phol" (close all timeloops and defeat all remaining entities) went with the timeloops. Only 4 chapters, because the visible achievements cover few themes. RAWG lists a playtime of only 5 hours, which looks low.
